title: Graduate positions 2026
location: Australia-wide offices including Melbourne VIC head office (Notting Hill)
content_text: Water Technology is recruiting for student internship and graduate positions for 2026. Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering and Science graduates or 3rd/4th year students are encouraged to apply. Applications close at 5pm (ACST) on 29th October. Melbourne head office at 15 Business Park Drive Notting Hill VIC. Early careers talent community also invites undergraduates and recent graduates to submit details and resume via Working With Us. Other Water Technology vacancies publish applications to recruitment@watertech.com.au.
apply_instructions: Apply via the Water Technology Jobs / Working With Us early-careers pathway linked from https://www.watertech.com.au/applications-now-open-graduates-interns/ (closes 5pm ACST 29 October). Recruitment inbox used on other WT roles: recruitment@watertech.com.au.
